name: PayHOA
description: Dues, the books, violation notices, and messages for a small homeowners association, especially a board of volunteers. Lexington, Kentucky. Michael Bollinger is the founder. The starting price is $49 a month for 1 to 25 units.

mentions.evidence: GetLatka shows $290,000 a year in November 2024, with the source not recorded. The site, read 11 November 2026, says more than 6,000 communities and more than 1,000 reviews on G2 and Capterra. A starting price of $49 a month and more than 6,000 communities would be a much larger bill than $290,000 a year, so that yearly figure looks old or partial. It is not treated as the current total. The price is the menu, not the revenue.
mentions.indieAngle: Dues, the split of the utility bill, and the announcement, for a small housing community.

whyItPrints: A volunteer treasurer does not want the spreadsheet or the chase for checks. Once the dues come out automatically, the board does not want to move.
